honestyBoundary: Titles are mapped from publicly verifiable material and standards where available; copyrighted books are not reproduced; runtime/provider evidence remains separate.

capabilities.title: ODN power budget and PON standards
capabilities.basis: ITU-T generation and budget classes; G.657 bend-radius registry
capabilities.limitation: Instrument and vendor/NMS measurements are not supplied by this static surface.

capabilities.title: Materials, splicing and fault taxonomy
capabilities.basis: FTTH Council Europe-oriented materials and operational taxonomy
capabilities.limitation: Field acceptance and calibration provenance still require buyer evidence.

capabilities.title: Tenant isolation tiers and noisy-neighbour budget
capabilities.basis: Explicit SILO / BRIDGE / POOL policy model with RLS requirement
capabilities.limitation: Live FORCE-RLS and adversarial cross-tenant execution remain unproven here.

capabilities.title: Partitioning, ordering, idempotency and replay
capabilities.basis: Deterministic event envelope and consumer/replay contracts
capabilities.limitation: A production broker, throughput SLO and hosted runtime are not claimed.

capabilities.title: CAS, interval exclusion and deadlock detection
capabilities.basis: Optimistic version checks, half-open booking intervals and wait-for cycles
capabilities.limitation: Database isolation behavior still requires PostgreSQL runtime evidence.

capabilities.title: BOLA, BFLA, SSRF and token-binding policy checks
capabilities.basis: OWASP API Top 10 (2023) policy evaluation helpers
capabilities.limitation: The helper is not a substitute for deployment WAF, identity or penetration evidence.

capabilities.title: Twelve-layer twin model, Zero Trust and drift checks
capabilities.basis: Layer registry, access controls and observed-versus-simulated drift
capabilities.limitation: The twin remains advisory; live GIS synchronization and predictive certainty are not claimed.

capabilities.title: Local retrieval with BM25, vector fusion and citations
capabilities.basis: Local chunk/index, rank fusion and evidence-bound answers
capabilities.limitation: No model, corpus, GPU, or offline production deployment is bundled by this page; runtime evidence is not present here.

capabilities.title: EOQ, safety stock, ABC/XYZ and demand forecast
capabilities.basis: Deterministic inventory policy and demand classification primitives
capabilities.limitation: Forecast quality depends on buyer history and does not invent missing demand data.

capabilities.title: First-time-right routing and financial decision primitives
capabilities.basis: Feasible visit planning, zero-revisit separation, EBITDA, DCF and covenants
capabilities.limitation: Outputs are deterministic decision support; no autonomous dispatch, payment or accounting certification is enabled, and runtime evidence is not present here.
